PRICING: repurchase price = NAV per share as of the last day of the immediately preceding quarter (repurchased shares are deemed repurchased on the last calendar day of the month immediately preceding the repurchase date for NAV-allocation, and bear no PPA/Management/Servicing/Distribution fees accrued in the first month of the repurchase quarter). CAP: 5.0% per calendar quarter of the aggregate NAV attributable to the plan-covered classes - Class S, D, U, I, R-S, R-D, R-U, R-I and F Shares (i.e., Investor Shares plus Class F) - measured using the average aggregate NAV attributable to those classes as of the end of the immediately preceding quarter. PRORATION: requests due to death, divorce, dissolution, bankruptcy, insolvency or adjudicated incompetence are satisfied first, then remaining requests pro rata (allocated without regard to class); unsatisfied requests do NOT carry over - they must be resubmitted the next quarter. WITHDRAWAL: requests may be withdrawn before the plan's quarterly deadline (specific deadline date not printed in the 10-K). EARLY REPURCHASE FEE: 5.0% of NAV if Investor Shares are repurchased within 24 months of issue (see 2.7). EXCESS SHARES: after settlement, the Board MAY (not must) tender for excess requests at about a 10% DISCOUNT to the most recent NAV. Minimum residual balance $1,000. Mandatory repurchases possible on 10 days' written notice. Board may modify/suspend the plan at will (disclosed via 8-K) but cannot terminate it absent a liquidity event; Class E Shares sit outside the plan.
